risk_summary: The disclosure presents a generally constructive outlook supported by quantified revenue, cost, budget, and asset metrics, but it highlights exposure to federal appropriations delays, continuing resolutions, procurement protests, labor shortages, pricing pressure, interest rates, and impairment assumptions. Risk language is largely standard MD&A boilerplate, with forward-looking claims relying on management beliefs and qualitative expectations. Goodwill and intangible assets represent a substantial portion of total assets, creating sensitivity to assumptions about cash flows, discount rates, …
